preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s inclusive.
The length of the string s is a multiple of k.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of substrings of length k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result[i]) == len(set(result[i])) for i in range(len(result)))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains unique characters.
Each line in the output is a subsequence of the corresponding substring of length k with duplicates removed.
